description: Tops up the traffic quota of an existing residential proxy, keeping its geo settings and connection string. Charges the account balance immediately; estimate_only=true returns the amount without charging. The remaining quota is residential_traffic_left_mb in list_proxies.

num.description: Plan multiplier: num=2 on a 10 GB plan means 20 GB
